# Analyze, Iterate, and Improve All Systems Prompt

## Purpose
Automate deep analysis, research, iterative improvement, expansion, automation, integration, implementation, creation, updating, logging, reporting, and review of all systems, logic, and files in the project.

## Logic
1. Analyze and define the purpose and logic of the specified area or the entire project.
2. Perform deep research to identify gaps, opportunities, and best practices.
3. Iterate improvements: refactor, expand, automate, and integrate as needed.
4. Implement and update code, docs, and supporting files.
5. Log actions, generate reports, and review results for completeness and quality.

## Output
- Clear summary of findings and actions
- Updated files and documentation
- Logs and reports of changes
- Review checklist and next steps

## Example Invocations
- "Analyze and improve all systems in the project."
- "Iterate and expand the asset manager logic."
- "Automate and integrate deck builder features."
- "Log and report on recent improvements."
- "Review and update documentation for all agents."
